My Unique Zip Code Bill is my all-time favorite piece of legislation! For decades, Members individually file their own legislation for the communities they represent in an effort to override frivolous rulings that can’t even be appealed for TEN YEARS!

This is now a nationwide bipartisan, bicameral bill that includes more than 60 communities that need their own Unique Zip Code.

I am proud to lead this effort, and what makes it “dumb” is that an act of Congress should not be needed to make these
